window_numeric_shape.first_column_semantics: separation s in Mpc/h, consistent with Beutler et al. 2017 Appendix A / Eq. 22 W_l^2(s) window multipoles

interpretation: The Beutler fallback is immutably bound and directly Fourier-binned, but its released survey-window objects are separation-space W_l^2(s) multipoles, not a finite non-negative true-k mixing matrix. Under frozen H3, obtaining an all-k positive support envelope would require an additional theory weighting or post-hoc cutoff, which is forbidden.
next_admissible_step: Prospectively freeze and audit a public clustering release that explicitly publishes finite true-k window/mixing matrices, beginning with Beutler & McDonald 2021 unified BOSS DR12 products.
